title: Passenger Flow Forecasting
description: Follow the code, generated plots, and model results as one connected analysis workflow.

zh-Hant.title: 客流量預測
zh-Hant.description: 依序理解程式碼、生成圖表與模型結果如何串成完整分析流程。

artifacts.label: Passenger Flow Over Time
artifacts.alt: Line chart showing simulated passenger flow over 168 time points
artifacts.caption: A deterministic synthetic series combining trend, daily and weekly patterns, and random noise.

zh-Hant.label: 客流量時間序列
zh-Hant.alt: 顯示 168 個時間點之模擬客流量的折線圖
zh-Hant.caption: 此可重現的合成序列結合趨勢、日週期、週週期與隨機雜訊。

artifacts.label: Passenger Flow Forecast
artifacts.alt: Line chart comparing actual and forecast passenger flow
artifacts.caption: The weighted moving-average baseline follows recent movement while smoothing short-term noise.

zh-Hant.label: 客流量預測
zh-Hant.alt: 比較實際與預測客流量的折線圖
zh-Hant.caption: 加權移動平均基準會追蹤近期變化，同時平滑短期雜訊。

artifacts.label: Model Performance Comparison
artifacts.alt: Bar chart comparing RMSE for ARIMA, Random Forest, and LSTM
artifacts.caption: A lower RMSE indicates better predictive performance in this demonstration.

zh-Hant.label: 模型效能比較
zh-Hant.alt: 比較 ARIMA、Random Forest 與 LSTM 之 RMSE 的長條圖
zh-Hant.caption: 在此示範中，較低的 RMSE 代表較佳的預測效能。

artifacts.label: Forecast Error Distribution
artifacts.alt: Histogram showing the distribution of actual minus forecast errors
artifacts.caption: Residuals reveal the spread and direction of errors made by the baseline forecast.

zh-Hant.label: 預測誤差分布
zh-Hant.alt: 顯示實際值減預測值之誤差分布的直方圖
zh-Hant.caption: 殘差可呈現基準預測的誤差方向與分散程度。

sections.title: Code Case Overview
sections.summary: Understand the analysis pipeline and inspect the latest model results.

zh-Hant.title: 程式碼案例概覽
zh-Hant.summary: 理解分析流程並檢視最新模型結果。

blocks.title: From MATLAB output to a documented code case
paragraphs: This code case generates a repeatable passenger-flow dataset, builds a transparent forecast, and publishes every result as static repository content.
Each case section is declared in this case manifest. The HTML remains unchanged when sections, code files, or plots are reorganized.

zh-Hant.title: 將 MATLAB 輸出整理成有文件記錄的程式碼案例
paragraphs: 此程式碼案例會生成可重現的客流量資料、建立透明易懂的預測，並將所有結果發布為靜態案例庫內容。
每個案例章節都由案例內容清單宣告；重新安排章節、程式碼或圖表時，不必修改 HTML。

zh-Hant.label: 平均絕對誤差
zh-Hant.detail: 預測誤差的絕對值平均

zh-Hant.label: 均方根誤差
zh-Hant.detail: 放大較大誤差影響的指標

blocks.title: Model benchmark
blocks.description: The best result is selected from the published JSON, not hard-coded in the page.

zh-Hant.title: 模型基準比較
zh-Hant.description: 最佳結果由已發布的 JSON 自動選出，不會寫死在頁面中。

blocks.title: Published content only
blocks.content: Refresh Content reloads files already generated by MATLAB. It does not execute MATLAB in the browser.

zh-Hant.title: 只讀取已發布內容
zh-Hant.content: 「重新整理內容」只會載入 MATLAB 已生成的檔案，不會在瀏覽器中執行 MATLAB。

sections.title: Generate the Data
sections.summary: Build deterministic passenger-flow data from trend, periodic signals, and noise.

zh-Hant.title: 生成資料
zh-Hant.summary: 由趨勢、週期訊號與雜訊建立可重現的客流量資料。

blocks.title: A reproducible synthetic time series
paragraphs: The generator fixes the random seed and combines interpretable components. This keeps every run comparable while preserving realistic variation.

zh-Hant.title: 可重現的合成時間序列
paragraphs: 資料生成器會固定隨機種子並組合可解釋的成分，使每次執行皆可比較，同時保留合理的變化。

items.title: Set the seed
items.content: rng(42) makes the random component repeatable.

zh-Hant.title: 固定隨機種子
zh-Hant.content: rng(42) 讓隨機成分可以重現。

items.title: Combine components
items.content: Trend, daily periodicity, weekly periodicity, and noise form the observed flow.

zh-Hant.title: 組合各項成分
zh-Hant.content: 趨勢、日週期、週週期與雜訊共同形成觀測客流量。

items.title: Create the baseline
items.content: Only earlier observations are used to calculate each forecast value.

zh-Hant.title: 建立預測基準
zh-Hant.content: 每個預測值只使用更早的觀測資料計算。

sections.title: Build the Forecast
sections.summary: Compare the observed series with a transparent weighted moving-average baseline.

zh-Hant.title: 建立預測
zh-Hant.summary: 比較觀測序列與透明易懂的加權移動平均基準。

blocks.title: Why keep the model simple?
blocks.content: This code case documents a publishing workflow. A readable baseline keeps the relationship between inputs, code, and output easy to review.

zh-Hant.title: 為什麼使用簡單模型？
zh-Hant.content: 此程式碼案例記錄發布流程；容易閱讀的基準模型可讓輸入、程式碼與輸出之間的關係更容易檢視。

sections.title: Compare Models
sections.summary: Read model scores from JSON and identify the lowest RMSE automatically.

zh-Hant.title: 比較模型
zh-Hant.summary: 從 JSON 讀取模型分數，並自動找出最低 RMSE。

sections.title: Inspect Forecast Errors
sections.summary: Use the residual distribution to inspect bias and error spread.

zh-Hant.title: 檢查預測誤差
zh-Hant.summary: 利用殘差分布檢查偏差與誤差的分散程度。

blocks.title: Reading residuals
blocks.content: Errors are calculated as Actual − Forecast. A distribution centered near zero suggests limited systematic bias, while its width reflects uncertainty.

zh-Hant.title: 如何解讀殘差
zh-Hant.content: 誤差以「實際值 − 預測值」計算。分布若接近零，代表系統性偏差有限；分布寬度則反映不確定性。

sections.title: Trace the Source Code
sections.summary: Review the orchestration and plotting functions copied from the latest MATLAB run.

zh-Hant.title: 追蹤原始程式碼
zh-Hant.summary: 檢視最新 MATLAB 執行後複製的流程控制與繪圖函數。

blocks.title: The website displays the generated source files
paragraphs: Each code block loads a file declared in the artifact registry. New functions can be added to the repository documentation without creating new HTML pages.

zh-Hant.title: 網站會顯示已生成的原始程式檔
paragraphs: 每個程式碼區塊都會載入資源清單中宣告的檔案；新增函數時，可直接擴充案例庫文件，不必建立新的 HTML 頁面。
